headline: A 2015 law renames a border crossing in Douglas, Arizona, as the Raul Hector Castro Port of Entry.
what_it_does: The law gives a new official name to the U.S. Customs and Border Protection port of entry at First Street and Pan American Avenue in Douglas, Arizona. The new name honors Raul Hector Castro. The law does not change how the port operates, its staffing, or its rules for travelers.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on May 22, 2015.
